title: EventPayload
description:
An event's `type` and `payload`, typed (ADR-0013 §5.1). The wire form is the event's own
pair of keys: `{"type": "<event type>", "payload": {…}}`.

AccountName.description: Remote account name on a destination.

oneOf.description: A background trigger activated covered access.

A pause, cutoff, stop or cooldown blocked it (at most one per policy and reason per
hour).
The request was not covered; no decision was created.
`client.revoked` (also the terminal event of the client's own subscriptions).

ClientId.description:
⟨M06⟩ Revision 6 (ADR-0012 §3.6, §3.7): a paired management client, minted by the
runner at invitation (`cl_<32 hex>`). It names the enrollment line
(`heimdall-mgmt:<cid>`) and the bridge's argv; it is never a credential and never a
request field that sets a caller (ADR-0006 §18).

CloseReason.description: Why an owned connection was closed (ADR-0008 D8 item 2 table and item 3).

oneOf.description: The slot passed to another binding (masters).

Code.description: Stable semantic code (ADR-0006 §5). Readers treat an unlisted value as an error with exit 1.

ConnectionEventKind.description: Whether a connection started or closed.

ConnectionEventPayload.description: The `Connection` event payload: `{connection_id, kind, event, reason}`.

ConnectionId.description:
⟨M03⟩ Owned connection ID (an `owned_connections` row; ADR-0008 D8; m03-plan
§5 items 4, 4a). Runtime-generated; never a PID.

Connectivity.description: A remote environment's connectivity as the controller sees it (ADR-0012 §7.1).

last_seen_at.description: When the runner was last reached.

oneOf.description: The runner cannot be reached for a known reason.

CredentialLifecycle.description:
`credential_lifecycle`: one of `expired`, `revoked_locally`, `authority_withdrawn`,
`reserved` / `published` / `voided` (an issuance), `installed` / `destroyed` /
`reissued` / `lost` (a credential instance), told apart by `event`.

latest_possible_credential_expiry.description:
The latest instant a credential already issued may still be valid
(`authority_withdrawn`; `null` when none can be).

remote_pending.description: The grants whose remote effect is pending (`authority_withdrawn`).

decision_id.description:
The decision. Always stored; absent from what a paired reader receives (its
delivery removes every `decision_id`).

DecisionId.description: Server-issued decision record ID (ADR-0006 §3.1 attended confirmation).

revoked_on.description: The runners where this device's client was revoked.

EffectId.description:
⟨M06⟩ Revision 6 (ADR-0012 §7.2): a narrowing effect, minted by its producing
controller. Keyed with the authenticated producer, the typed target and its
generation.

EffectStatus.description: Whether an operation's external effect happened (spec §11.6).

oneOf.description: The effect was applied and verified.
Some steps applied; the result says which.
The effect may or may not have applied; reconcile before retrying.

EffectTarget.description:
A typed narrowing effect's target (ADR-0012 §7.2). With the authenticated producing
controller (the session's client, never a field) and the effect ID, it keys the
effect; each target carries its own generation.

oneOf.description:
Applied as a durable grant tombstone (ADR-0005 §6.1 "Revocation"), acknowledged
with its enforcement state.

Applied as a durable policy revision: running grants continue, new activations
are refused (§6.1 "Pause"). Not a tombstone.

Applied as a durable policy revision that also ends every affected grant like
expiry and refuses new grants until cleared (ADR-0005 §6.1 "Cutoff").
⟨rev6.1; M06-W0-R02, orchestrator ruling⟩ It carries the owner's instant `at` (as the
local `policy cutoff` request does). The runner's effective cutoff is
`min(existing, at)`: a delivered or replayed cutoff only shortens it, never delays it
(moving a cutoff later is a widening, runner-local). An `at` at or before trusted now
applies at the durable apply, with no signature after that commit; a future `at` is
persisted and enforced at `at` by the supervisor wake; under uncertain time it fires
as soon as `at` may have passed (the upper bound of now). Enforcement is m06-plan U4's.

operation_id.description: The operation that moved it, if any.

EnrollmentId.description:
⟨M03⟩ Enrollment record ID (m03-plan §5 item 1; ADR-0008 D5 §6.2). The remote
marker is `heimdall:<enrollment-id>`, so the ID is the add's idempotency key.

EnrollmentState.description:
The enrollment record's state (ADR-0008 D5 §6.2; revision 2's 20 states). The
allowed transitions are `heimdall_domain::enrollment::transition`.

oneOf.description: Operation admitted, awaiting the owner decision.
The approved operation is running; nothing remote is known written.
The append may or may not have applied.
Our marker or trust is present but wrong, or a check needs the owner.
The exact line is present; no verification has passed yet.
System form: waiting for the owner to apply the sshd lines.
Positive passed and negative refused with full evidence.
A later verification is running; never removes anything.
The initial verification failed; removing our line under the decision.
The rollback's removal may or may not have applied (rollback purpose).
An explicit owner-decided removal is running.
The explicit removal may or may not have applied (removal purpose).
System form: the owner is to remove the sshd lines.
System form: the absence check runs.
Final: the rollback removed our line.
Final: nothing of ours remains as last observed.
The owner gave the account up; trust may remain (`pending_until_line_removed`).

GrantState.description: Grant states (spec §6.3 table). Terminal states never reactivate the same grant.

oneOf.description: Intent recorded; no usable access promised.
Specified capability verified within recorded evidence freshness.
Some capability unavailable; authorized repair may proceed.
Local denial applied; remote effects may be pending.
Terminal: required preparation could not complete.

reason.description:
Why it is degraded (`mechanism_unavailable`, `credential_reissue_pending`,
`pair_unenrolled`); present only on a degraded grant.

OperationState.description: Operation states (spec §11.4). A caller timeout is not a state change.

oneOf.description: Accepted and journaled; not yet running.
Waiting for an owner or provider decision on an owner channel.
Settled: failed with a classified error.

Settled: explicitly cancelled; the result says whether an irreversible or
uncertain step may have occurred.

Unresolved: an external effect may or may not have applied. Quiescent until
reconciliation settles it to `succeeded` or `failed`; never purged while
unresolved; never retried blindly.

code.description: Its code, `null` while it has none.

effect_status.description: Its effect status. Every emission site writes a value; a `null` reads as absent.

cutoff_at.description: Its cutoff, `null` when it has none.

PolicyTarget.description:
What a narrowing or block action applies to (ADR-0011 §7.3 "Targets"; m05-plan §4
item 2), tagged by `kind`.

RemoteEffectEventPayload.description:
Payload of `EventType::RemoteEffect` (not emitted by wave 0): the effect's key
(ADR-0012 §7.2), its target carrying the target generation.

producer.description: The producing controller (its authenticated client on that runner).

target.description: The typed target, with its generation.

ResourceChanged.description:
`resource_changed`: a declaration (`declaration_revision`, `change: declared`), a
projection item (`item`, `generation`, `change`), or a supervised resource
(`resource_id`, `kind`, `generation`, `outcome`, `code|null`, `attempts`; no `change`).

change.description:
What changed (`declared`, `applied`, `rolled_back`, `repaired`, `restored`, `held`,
`conflict`); absent on a supervised resource.

code.description: A supervised resource's code, `null` when none.

generation.description: The projection generation, or a supervised resource's generation.

RestoreEpoch.description:
A restore epoch (ADR-0014 §3.6 "The restore epoch and the replay fence"). Every restore
raises it, durably, before its pointer moves; a store with no restore is at epoch 0, and
every reference minted before revision 7's migration belongs to epoch 0.

subscription_ended.description: Whether the stream ends after it. Revision 7: every gap ends the stream.

Role.description:
A paired client's role on a runner (ADR-0012 §3.8). The local same-user caller is
always `owner` (ADR-0006 §2.1); `requester` and `viewer` are defined here and unused
until the role table lands (m06-plan U1).

RouteAttempt.description: One tried route of an attempt.

duration_ms.description:
⟨rev6.5; ADR-0006 §18.9 item 11⟩ How long the attempt took, in milliseconds, at
most [`ROUTE_ATTEMPT_DURATION_MAX_MS`]; omitted when it was not measured.

failure.description: Its failure; absent when this route was used.

oneOf.description: `route.health`: one attempt's structured result, written for every attempt.

`route.failed_over`: the subtype of `route.health` for an attempt that moved past
a failed route.

RouteFailureClass.description: Why one route attempt failed (ADR-0012 §5.5 item 4).

oneOf.description: Connect refused (or the jump leg exited) before identification.
No SSH identification line within the route's bound.
The Iroh serving side refused admission before identification.

A failure after the first forwarded byte: terminal for the attempt, never failed
over.

⟨rev6.1⟩ The jump leg failed SSH host-key verification or authentication at the jump
host before identification: terminal, never failed over (ADR-0012 §5.5 item 3).

⟨M06 exit, Q-B⟩ The leg's driver is not in this build (an Iroh leg in a build without
the `iroh` feature): never dialed, failed over.

RouteHealthPayload.description:
Payload of `EventType::Route` (not emitted by wave 0), also readable through
`inspect`. The helper's exit codes stay internal (ADR-0012 §1.5).

final_route.description: The route finally used; absent when none was.

RouteId.description:
⟨M06⟩ Revision 6 (ADR-0012 §5.1): one approved route of a destination. Reachability
data only; a route grants nothing and never changes host identity.

reason.description: Why it is unresolved (an open set: any operation's reason).

oneOf.description: No lock source on this platform or session.

StateRestoredPayload.description:
⟨H4, H10⟩ The payload of a `state_restored` event: what the restore ended
(ADR-0014 §3.6's table). Counts and opaque IDs only.

exposure_disabled.description: Exposure and admission state disabled (`exposure_disabled_after_restore`), by kind.

grants_ended.description:
Grants (with their bindings, slots and owned connections) ended, each with a
tombstone.

policies_paused.description: Standing policies paused, with a cutoff at the restore time.

restore_epoch.description: The restore epoch after the restore.
